narrative.details: The waters of Lake Elune'ara should dissolve the nightmares engulfing this object. Give me a moment to perform the cleansing, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Wait for Keeper Remulos at the Moonglade to cleanse the Nightmare Engulfed Object.
narrative.offerRewardText: Take his ring, adventurer. It has served its purpose for Malfurion. It shall now serve a new purpose for you...

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 9,950 XP in all.

quests.name: Shrouded in Nightmare
quests.objectiveText: Find someone capable of deciphering the meaning behind the Nightmare Engulfed Object. Perhaps a druid of great power could assist you.
